summary: Quiet, airy and reverent: soft pastel light, rounded forms and generous space, warm enough to feel human rather than clinical.

references.key_choice: Pale blue-to-lavender gradients behind rounded cards
Fully rounded controls with thin, even line icons
Gentle organic shapes framing the content
Muted sage and lavender fills with quiet serif-free type

references.description: Minimal photo covers with quiet type
references.key_choice: Soft-focus natural light photography, small type, lots of air

observations.pattern: Cool pastel palette (pale blue, lavender, sage) with low contrast between surfaces
Rounded geometry everywhere: cards, buttons, icons, motifs
Depth comes from gradients and translucency, not borders or shadows
Type is small, light and well spaced; hierarchy is quiet

style_axes.target: Minimal with a touch of warmth; one expressive motif per screen at most
Soft and rounded; no sharp corners on any interactive element
Reverent but approachable; never solemn or heavy
Light dimensionality from gradients and translucency, not drop shadows

color_mood.description: Cool, pastel-leaning palette with pale blues, lavender, sage and muted neutrals; gentle gradients for depth. Text needs a deep, warm-grey anchor so the softness stays readable.
avoid: harsh pure black on pure white

typography_mood.description: Clean, friendly sans-serif with soft geometry, medium weights and generous spacing; clear, quiet hierarchy.
dos: use a rounded or humanist sans
keep body text at 16px or larger with 1.5 line height
add breathing room between lines and sections
donts: use sharp geometric or ultra-condensed fonts
set body text in light weights on pastel grounds
stack more than two type styles on one screen

imagery_rules.photography_or_illustration: Serene photography or soft, minimal illustration; imagery feels contemplative and airy.
dos: use natural light and soft focus
favour subtle silhouettes and gentle shapes
use card-based modules with 16–24px corner radius
donts: use dense grids with tight gutters
add heavy borders or hard outlines

motion_rules.description: Slow, settling motion: things fade and drift into place rather than snapping.
dos: fall back to the final state instantly when reduced motion is on

cliche_watch.risk: Generic meditation-app look: lavender gradient, lotus, sunrise.
cliche_watch.guardrail: No lotus, sunrise or praying-hands icons; one gradient per screen; let the wreath/cloud motif be the only ornament.

accessibility_watchouts: Pastel text on pastel grounds will fail WCAG AA; keep text on the deep text colour and use the accent for fills only
Thin icons on gradients lose definition; check 3:1 against the lightest point of the gradient
Translucent panels over photography need a solid fallback for legibility

logo: Explore rounded, open forms that work in one colour
Test at 16px before adding any gradient
ui: Define one ground, one text colour and one accent as tokens first
Build the card and button with the final radius before any screens
content: Shoot or source soft natural-light imagery with no people in focus
Keep headlines short; the space does the talking

references_summary: Minimal photo covers with quiet type
assumptions: Primary surface is a mobile app, with social and app-store assets second
Audience is adults using the app daily in quiet moments
Hex values are proposals to test, not sampled from the references
risks_or_watchouts: Over-softening can reduce contrast and readability
Too many gradients can feel dated or cliché
Avoid slipping into generic meditation-app tropes
